shortlist.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma with MYC and BCL6 rearrangements
shortlist.why_kept: Gains of fluorescence signal at 3q27 (BCL6) and 8q24 (MYC) on fluorescence in situ hybridization, and CD138-positive

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138 and CD56 positivity, along with EBV positivity and the absence of CD20 and PAX5 expression, are characteristic of plasmablastic lymphoma. The gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6), 8q24 (MYC), and 14q32 (IGH), also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Extramedullary plasmacytoma
rejected.why: While CD138 positivity is seen in extramedullary plasmacytoma, the presence of EBV positivity and the specific immunophenotypic profile are more characteristic of plasmablastic lymphoma.

rejected.label: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The immunophenotypic profile, particularly the lack of NK cell markers and the presence of CD138 and CD56, does not support this diagnosis.
